scope: documentation-only preparation; no claim of a current healthy UE session

proof_tiers.T0_source: Static source/topology only; no execution claim.
proof_tiers.T1_offline: Contract, syntax, or native build; no editor-route claim.
proof_tiers.T2_scoped_runtime: One named PIE route with marker and clean scoped log.
proof_tiers.T3_player_visible: Real input plus visible viewport/UI behavior.
proof_tiers.T4_durable_loop: Required save/reload or replay boundary passes.

serialized_live_gates.proof: Average plus detector; zero Blueprint Runtime Error, Accessed None, Fatal, and Ensure after the marker.
Exactly one main battle widget and one rhythm surface through a visible open/close cycle.
One real key input reaches damage exactly once.
One rated input reaches the stock resolver and shows a matching result.
Approved cosmetic grant/equip is restored by save, reload, and ApplyWardrobeState.
An approved capability changes Glide availability and restores correctly.
One owner-approved level host plays a phrase then commits across replay/reload.
Approved rig plus definition, first spawn, follow, and Graze/Harmonize/Guide range smoke.

entry_requirements: One healthy editor only, bound to the agreed endpoint.
Prewritten marker, expected actors, duration, teardown check, and forbidden patterns.

owner_decisions.decision: Name one allowed active level and host; global attachment is prohibited.
Resolve the conflict between L_ChoralSheep_Prototype and MelodiaIntegrationMap in the owning runbook.
Provide the owner-approved rig at the reserved path; Groom and animation remain optional for the first smoke.
